title: Filipino Yeast Keto Dumplings
description: A unique twist on traditional dumplings, these Filipino-inspired yeast keto dumplings are the perfect low-carb snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine tender pork shoulder, Filipino yeast, olive oil, almond flour, Parmesan cheese, egg, garlic powder, and salt. Mix well until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with olive oil and dot with butter.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
